title: 殿下がバザーにやってきた！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion and I are on the way back from a day out when, at her insistence, we stop by a bazaar.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Wow! There are so many little stalls! They're just like the ones we saw selling food at the festival!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I was just thinkin' the two of ya looked familiar! How's it goin'?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ines! Tamamo! Are you enjoying the market as well?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh, you betcha! This bazaar a big deal for us!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: We show up, do a little rummaging, and always walk away with bunches and bunches of neat stuff! And all on the cheap! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Is that so?! I'm getting more excited by the second!

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: All units, enter alpha formation! We must ensure that no harm comes to the entourage!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Boy, those bodyguards of yours are as slick as ever. That said…

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Urghhh… Mommy, they're scary!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh my, my. It looks like the little ones are a little flustered.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …Captain, why don't we take our leave? At this rate, we'll only end up bothering the other attendees.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I don't wish to frighten the children enjoying the bazaar. I'm quite satisfied with simply having seen it from afar.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa whoa whoa whoa whoa, hold on a sec! Instead of callin' it quits…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahem! Why don't we act as your guards? ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah! If I spot any suspicious-lookin' weirdos lurkin' around, I'll cuff 'em 'n take 'em downtown.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: If the two of you are willing to act as escorts, then we needn't worry. The rest of us will assume beta formation and survey the situation from the background.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: My gratitude to you all for your continued kindness. Well then, shall we? ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: All right, we gotta hit this stall first! It's me and Ines's favorite!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: They have clothing, and toys, and—goodness, are these accessories handmade?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Bazaars sell more than just second-hand stuff. They have handcrafted items too.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Is that so? Then, I believe I'll purchase this one. Pardon me, but are you the one who made this?

text_block_list.name: Bazaar Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: That's right… Wait a sec… Are you Fine Motion?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: This item has utterly captivated me. You're a wonderful craftsperson. ♪

text_block_list.name: Bazaar Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Oh, n-not at all! Y-you're too kind!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What the… From this angle, it looks kinda like there's a halo hoverin' over Fine's head…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Tamamo, Ines! Thank you both so much for making this wonderful experience possible.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Th-that bright smile! I'm blind!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion continues to enjoy the bazaar, leisurely going from one stall to the next.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, is it closing time already? It feels like it's only been a moment.
choice_data_list: You sure had some great security.
You sure had some great security.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, is it closing time already? It feels like it's only been a moment.
choice_data_list: You sure had some great security.
You sure had some great security.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I did! I found some real treasures, thanks to everyone's help. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah, you went head-over-heels for that T-shirt ya got at the end.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, what did you buy? Show me! Show me! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That's quite a shirt… It's got a gigantic kanji for "noodles" on the front…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Precisely! I've never seen a T-shirt with a design like this before, so I just couldn't help myself. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah. Now that's chic. I bet my grandma back home'd like it too!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hm, I might hang it in my room to remember today by. Hehe. Bazaars really are wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion looks overjoyed after spending a fun day at the bazaar with her friends.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I sure did! In fact, I hope I can rely on them again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: We gotcha covered! Bargain huntin's serious business, after all. Next time, we'll even let you in on some trade secrets.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Maybe next time we could try shopping at another market!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank you both so much! With you two by my side, I feel like I'm going to learn a great deal about Japan's shopping culture and etiquette!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ngh! Looks like I better get used to this majestic glow!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ya can say that again…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion's friends find themselves dazzled by the sheer majesty she radiates from time to time.
